record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change only NextItNet residual scaling from 0.5 to 0.35 in every causal convolution block. The improvement at 0.5 motivates testing whether further damping preserves useful input information and stabilizes the six-block stack. Keep features, embeddings, dilation schedule, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed. Synchronize residual-scale metadata and predictor-writer checks; retain one trained model per category.
